chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, raising it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) overturning his cloak when he prayed for rain, so he said: 'A sign between him and his companions, that aridity is turned into fertility.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and symbolic meaning behind the Prophet overturning his cloak during the rain prayer?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates that the Prophet’s act of overturning his cloak during Salat al-Istisqa was not merely ritualistic but served as a distinct visible sign (alamah) for his companions to recognize the imminent shift from drought to abundance. This specific gesture underscores the Shia understanding of the Prophet’s unique spiritual authority in manifesting divine blessings, linking the physical act directly to the tangible transformation of the land from barrenness to fertility.
